summary: Appraise, prioritize, and monitor public capital projects with practical tools. Explore the five-day public investment management course.
lede: Public investment management training helps finance and planning officials, infrastructure practitioners, and development programme staff assess public capital projects. Participants screen proposals, build prioritized pipelines, apply cost-benefit and multi-criteria analysis, and test affordability and procurement readiness. They also create spreadsheet-based monitoring tools, review implementation risks, and draft measures for evaluating project results.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape, appraise, fund, procure, or monitor public capital projects across government and development programmes.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with public budgeting, project appraisal, or capital project delivery is recommended. No coding is required. Bring a laptop with Microsoft Excel or compatible spreadsheet software for the practical exercises.
